screenFade.evidence: XML1 registers screenFade and cameraFade to the same function (xbe 0x98ec0); XML2 cameraFade 0x49df70 has identical body

getMissionVar.evidence: XML1 mission store == XML2 zone store (xbe 0xcac70/0xcb780 vs exe 0x4d6840/0x4d7060, 32 names, <12 chars) but XML2 clears it on every zone load (0x49fe70) while XML1 clears only on map-directory change (xbe 0x99b90 + dir compare 0x824c0)

setMissionVar.evidence: as getMissionVar; XML2 has no int game-var setter, game vars are only reachable bit-wise (setGameFlag 0x4a0120 -> 0x4d7130)

getMissionFlag.evidence: identical bit code (xbe 0x98cb0 vs exe 0x4a0190: bit 1..32, returns 0/1); same name kept so conversation conditions disallowResponseOnVar(name,bit) keep working (exe 0x49da20 checks game store first)

getGameVar.xml2_replacement: packed getGameFlag bits in x1g* game vars
getGameVar.evidence: XML1 game store (xbe 0xcacd0, 16 names) ~ XML2 game store (0x4d68a0, 100 names) but XML2 exposes it only through get/setGameFlag

setGameVar.xml2_replacement: packed setGameFlag bits in x1g* game vars

createPopupDialog.evidence: XML2 only has XML-file dialogs (createPopupDialogXml 0x4a6890); dialog XML schema identical in both exes (attrs text/cancancel/autohide/scriptok/scriptcancel/filter/hud, <option text script>)

addPopupDialogOption.xml2_replacement: <option text=.. script=..> in the generated dialog
addPopupDialogOption.evidence: option scripts run as console "runscript %s" (xbe 0x1877e0, exe 0x5eb8e3) -> must be one whitespace-free token

beginMission.xml2_replacement: setCurrentAct(act) + objective resets + scriptstart body / loadMapKeepTeam(mapload) (scripts/x1/missions/begin_<m>.py)
beginMission.evidence: XML2 beginMission (0x4a0af0) queues console "beginmission %s" but no such command is registered in XMen2.exe (only format string at 0x68d2e8); XML1 handler xbe 0x18da90 loads data/missions/<m> then runs scriptstart

beginSideMission.xml2_replacement: begin block of the side mission
beginSideMission.evidence: XML1 "beginsidemission" = pushsidemission + beginmission (xbe 0x18dd70); XML2 only pushes via extractionPointChange (0x4a7020)

endSideMission.evidence: XML2 restorelastzone handler 0x5f4580 is the XML1 endsidemission handler (xbe 0x18df20) renamed; without a pushed side mission it has nothing to restore, so returns are resolved statically

setInCampaign.evidence: XML1 0x99460 and XML2 0x49f520 both call registry->vtbl+0x2c(registry->vtbl+0x3c(name)); "FALSE" is a no-op in XML1

addHero.evidence: XML1 0x99a00 game->vtbl+0x110(name); no XML2 script function reaches the party-add method

destroyMultipartPiece.evidence: npcstat <Multipart> of Juggernaut: hideSkin 3401_helmet, showSkin 3401_head, effectOnDeath explode/JuggernautHelmet, bone Bip01 Head

displayEx.evidence: XML1 stub: xbe 0x2123a0 = xor eax,eax; ret

mission.evidence: XML1 0x99420 -> mission manager vtbl+8(name,state); XML2 has no mission-list state

loadMap.evidence: XML1 loadMap sends "loadmap %s" (xbe 0x9a850, extra args default 0 0); XML2 loadMap sends "loadmapaddteam %s" (no such command registered) and loadMapKeepTeam sends "loadmap %s 0 0" (0x4a0cc0)

extractionPointLite.evidence: XML1 sig asssss (xbe 0x9f4a0) vs XML2 asss (0x4a6d80); mapping of the flags unverified
